# Font Awesome 6 Free (solid)

- `fa-solid-900.ttf` from [Font Awesome 6.7.2](https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome) (SIL OFL 1.1)
- `IconsFontAwesome6.h` from [IconFontCppHeaders](https://github.com/juliettef/IconFontCppHeaders)

Used as a merged icon font for Dear ImGui buttons (see imgui `docs/FONTS.md`).
